usage: jbus item [-h] {propose,approve,drop,show,list} ...

positional arguments:
  {propose,approve,drop,show,list}
    propose             a new item, with no row
    approve             the user's go for an item
    drop                an item that will not be done
    show                an item, its risk and its lines
    list                every item, one line each

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
